Subject: Sandbox credits -- brief favor?

Hi Sofia,

Quick one — we're in the middle of a PoC of Redwood for our synthesis pipeline but procurement hit a snag and our billing contact is out until Monday. Our sandbox has effectively run dry and the integration team is blocked. Could you help with a short-term bridge (enough to cover ~35k tokens) so we can finish the last validation tests next week? We expect to convert to a committed Dedicated pool if the tests pass — has been a great start.

A few quick facts to help evaluate:
- Account: Catalyst Labs (internal id: CL-4098)
- Current trial balance: 0 tokens
- Projected consumption to finish validation: ~35k tokens over 5 days
- Business contact: Priya Shah (Engineering Manager) copied here

If there's a formal approval process we can expedite on our side — happy to sign an addendum or accept a one-time credit agreement. Appreciate any help.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Director of Engineering
Catalyst Labs
liam@catalystlabs.com

Hi Liam — thanks for the context and for outlining the numbers.

We can often provide a short-term bridge credit for proof-of-concept projects in cases like this. To move quickly, can you confirm two items for us:
1) the HubSpot company id (so I can attach to the deal) or the direct account link;
2) confirmation that you (Catalyst Labs) are OK with a one-time, non-recurring credit and a short addendum that documents the amount and timeframe.

I’m looping in Marcus (AE) so he can expedite approvals. If Marcus is good with the numbers today we can provision an interim credit and follow up with the addendum from Legal.

Proposed quick option: one-time 50,000 token credit valid for 14 days — gives your team some headroom. If that works, please reply-all with the HubSpot link and we'll kick off the paperwork.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
